name: math-block-normalizer
description: Local Quartz 5 transformer plugin that rewrites single-line "$$formula$$" display equations onto three lines (opening $$, formula, closing $$) before remark-math parses them, so they're correctly classified as block/display math and get MathJax's display="true" attribute (and therefore base.scss's centering rule) instead of being silently downgraded to inline math. Operates purely in-memory on each file's markdown source at build time; nothing on disk in content/ is changed.

quartz.name: math-block-normalizer
quartz.description: Rewrites single-line $$formula$$ display equations onto three lines so remark-math classifies them as block math and they render centered.
